proposed.text: Which compensation and conflict rule matches Sections 2-h and 2-i?

options.text: Compensation should come through the client fee, and business interests affecting the client should be disclosed.
The architect may secretly accept outside returns from interested sources.
The architect should avoid informing the client about related business interests.
